## Telegram → existing CareerSphere chatbot
Inspired by template #9254. This game has ONE local player. Set `ownerTelegramId` in Normalize private update and the SAME single ID in chatbot `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS`.

1. Select a Telegram credential in Telegram updates. 2. Set chatbotBaseUrl. 3. Select Header Auth in Forward to existing chatbot: `X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token` = chatbot `TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

Set AI_PROVIDER=deepseek, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and DEEPSEEK_MODEL=deepseek-flash in BOTH chatbot and game server Secrets (same key); restart both services. The key never belongs in workflow JSON.

Chatbot handles classification, confirmation buttons, POST /api/integrations/chat, persistence and replies. n8n does not send a second reply. Attachments receive the existing text-only response. Only one Telegram webhook per bot: activating this workflow replaces the direct Python webhook. Keep chatbot TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN set for replies. Public HTTPS WEBHOOK_URL required for n8n.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item => ({json: {status: item.json.status, replyHandledBy: item.json.replyHandledBy, note: 'The existing chatbot classifies messages, calls the game API and sends Telegram replies.'}}));
